title: Biking Barcelona – Totally Worth It
text: The tour was a little over 3 hours. They did a great job of showing you the diversity of the city. Our guide was knowledgable and shared a lot of interesting things about the city and its history.  Also, it's a good way to learn how to bike in Barcelona in general.  I loved it.  I highly recommend it.
author: tomsO1217EI

text:
What a fantastic bike tour through Barcelona! We took the tour with a group of 10 people and had an amazing time. Claire provided clear explanations and shared her knowledge with great enthusiasm and passion. Thanks to her engaging stories and insights, we got a wonderful impression of the city.

The tour lasted about 2 hours, which was the perfect length for us. We got to see a lot of Barcelona without it becoming tiring. It’s also great that there are other bike tours available and that everything is offered in Dutch.

A huge compliment to Claire and her entire team. Even with our group of 1
author: Daydream23598369665

title: Recommended
text: Really good and exciting trip through Barcelona
author: Pooul

title: Cozy and educational bike tour
text: Our guide Zafan guided us in a smooth and cozy way along spots in Barcelona that were off the beaten path. This alternated with the classics. The tour was also perfect in terms of duration with a short stop along the beach along the way. Highly recommended!
author: Liesbeth V

title: Great tour!
text: Perfect length for tour.  Went to different places than typical Barcelona tours which I appreciated as I have been to Barcelona several times before.  Guide was upbeat and knowledgeable.  Mostly rode on bike paths so avoided dodging car traffic,
author: KCGirl2014edith

title: Different view of Barcelona via bike tour
text: Karin was a fun and entertaining bike tour guide for our bike tour in Barcelona! We loved all the sights she took us too bc we have been to Barcelona a handful times but this bike tour definitely gave us a different and fun perception of the city. Enjoy it tremendously and highly recommend it!
author: 954sandyk

title: Super fun

author: R4885ZTmoniquev

title: Great tour. Don't rent an e-bike but give the guide a deserved tip!
text:
Despite the bad weather, it was an unforgettable bike ride along all kinds of special places in Barcelona. The guide Olivier knew many nice anecdotes in a visual way 
With great enthusiasm and humor to tell. The story of Gaudi and the tram was beautiful, you then look at the sagrada familia and Casa Batllo with different eyes..
There is no need to rent an e-bike as it is a relaxed tour. You can better spend the money you save with this on tips for the guide
author: Hoekstee

title: Barcelona from the bike! Seen so much with a nice group!
text: What a super fun tour with places we never found ourselves. Fine bikes and enthusiastic tour guide Pepijn!
